# TPE Mats Factory

> 3D TPE Car Floor Liners Direct from the Factory

Custom-fit TPE car mats: 3D moulded floor liners, cargo liners and all-weather mats for 425 vehicle models across 54 makes, sold FOB China to importers, distributors and accessory wholesalers. 879 product pages state price, MOQ, material and coverage, and 738 of them also print the tooling reference the part is moulded from. Every vehicle page states the exact make, model, year band, body type and drive side it fits.

## Categories

- [3D TPE Floor Liners](https://tpematsfactory.com/floor-liners/): 597 listings. Laser-measured 3D full-coverage liners with high side walls and OE fixing points.
- [All-Weather Floor Mats](https://tpematsfactory.com/all-weather-mats/): 79 listings. Flat and semi-universal TPE mats for year-round protection against mud, snow and spills.
- [Trunk Mats & Cargo Liners](https://tpematsfactory.com/trunk-mats/): 164 listings. Boot and cargo-area liners cut to the load floor, with raised edges.
- [Double-Layer Mats](https://tpematsfactory.com/double-layer-mats/): 39 listings. Detachable two-layer construction: lift the top layer out, hose the base.

## Fitment index

- [Shop by vehicle](https://tpematsfactory.com/shop-by-vehicle/): 425 vehicle models across 54 makes, 854 linked product cards. Each page gathers everything that fits one model, plus the year band and drive side it was tooled for.
- [Fitment finder](https://tpematsfactory.com/#finder): pick year, make and model to jump to the pages that fit it.

## Guides

- [TPE vs PVC vs Rubber Car Mats: What Importers Must Know](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/tpe-vs-pvc-vs-rubber-car-mats-importer-guide/): TPE, PVC or rubber car mats: how odour, cold flexibility, weight and moulding accuracy change your landed cost, your returns rate and your price point.
- [How to Specify Custom-Fit Floor Liners: Importer Checklist](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/how-to-specify-custom-fit-floor-liners/): A step-by-step specification checklist for custom-fit floor liner orders: year and generation, drive side, positions, fixing points, samples and PO wording.
- [OEM Car Mat Sourcing: From Vehicle Scan to Container](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/oem-car-mat-sourcing-vehicle-scan-to-container/): How an OEM car mat programme runs: tooling choice, first-article samples, QC checks, carton marking, container loading, compression and customs paperwork.
- [TPE Car Mat Fitment Index: 425 Models, 54 Makes](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/tpe-car-mat-fitment-index-425-models-54-makes/): What our fitment index covers: 425 vehicle models from 54 makes, how many entries carry an exact model year, and how to verify your own year before you order.
- [Car Mat MOQ and Price Units: 879 Listings Counted](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/car-mat-moq-and-price-units-879-listings/): 331 of 879 listings start at one set and 283 at ten, while 188 quote a price per piece. What the printed minimums and price units mean for a first order.
- [Fitment Depth: Listings Behind 425 Vehicle Pages](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/car-mat-fitment-depth-listings-per-vehicle-page/): 301 of 425 vehicle pages carry one listing and 124 carry two or more: how listing depth, covered positions and year sourcing vary by model.
- [Same Price, Same MOQ: Are the Listings Duplicates?](https://tpematsfactory.com/blog/duplicate-car-mat-listings-same-price-moq/): 879 listings resolve to 447 model families, and 102 groups share a price and MOQ. Four fields decide whether two listings are the same product.

## Notes

- Prices are quoted FOB China in USD, per piece or per set; MOQ is stated on every product page.
- Vehicle pages are built from vehicle-specific moulds, not from a universal trim-to-fit pattern.
- TPE is used without a plasticiser, so the mats are odourless, halogen-free and 100 percent recyclable.
- Year bands are the band the part was tooled for; fitment changes between generations, so an exact year is confirmed against the tooling before quoting.
